set: B: tier 3 from above, the lobby doors and the table map beside the approved images, whole and in crops

issues.where: whole Corporate tier, especially the tower, ladder and beach case
issues.what: The near-orthographic viewpoint reads like a plan. The tower is almost all roof and its lit vertical façade disappears; exposed sides of the neighboring pieces collapse too. The target reads as a view down onto a physically deep table.
issues.fix: Use a more oblique overhead camera from the flipper end, preserving configured part sizes and prescribed sign tilt, so the tower front, plinths, case walls and raised rails are legible.

issues.where: close shot framing, upper half and both bottom corners
issues.what: The tall tower has a visible roof against extensive black space, with a conspicuous silver and orange band behind it. Giant partial floor inserts and silver rails crowd the foreground. The target is an entrance portrait with the façade filling the top and clear carpet and dark floor at the bottom.
issues.fix: Reframe and roll the camera to give the façade more of the upper field and the entrance fascia a stronger diagonal; keep the far perimeter, oversized foreground inserts as projected, and edge hardware out of the composition without changing prescribed part scales or revolving-door placement.

issues.where: entrance, floor and foreground carpet
issues.what: Cold hard glints and repetitive whitish overhead lamps dominate instead of warm lobby spill. The floor picks up broad white glare, the carpet looks like regular red ribs, and the ball has only a thin reflection under it rather than an observable soft shadow spreading toward the foreground and a bright spot on the pile.
issues.fix: Use fine irregular velvet-like pile, restore localized warm spill and softly defined floor reflections, and ground the ball with a broad soft cast shadow and a small bright refracted spot. Leave its take position and scale alone.

issues.where: Corporate tier, upper-left boardroom and right ladder
issues.what: The long table is turned front-to-back with the paper row at its short end, and the access ladder is swung crosswise, overlapping the slingshot and pressing against the beach case. The target separates a crosswise boardroom and right-hand diagonal approach into legible pockets.
issues.fix: Rotate the boardroom and organize its chairs and papers across the upper-left bay; return the ladder approach to an up-right diagonal, keeping clearance from the right slingshot and beach case.

issues.where: navy playfield, around carpet and between flippers
issues.what: Oversized dense gold arcs and a prominent stair or grille pattern under the center inserts replace the target's sparse fan linework and calm dark gaps. The table surface below them is broadly cloudy and unmarked rather than fine-grained, worn and glossy at points of light.
issues.fix: Restore the sparse layout of the gold tracery, especially below the carpet, and use finer navy grain, light local wear and more localized reflections instead of broad mottling.

issues.where: upper and right lane surfaces and borders
issues.what: The top and right are broad blue bands with little round light rings, rather than a discrete dark rail channel with inset rectangular lamp windows and warm metallic highlights.
issues.fix: Make the track read as a distinct metal-sided channel and use glazed elongated inset windows with defined markings and local pools of light; preserve intended lamp directions and tube openings.

issues.where: tower crop, façade, roof and sign
issues.what: The central roof appears to be nested grids of almost identical bulbs on a featureless charcoal frame. The façade has little pane-to-pane variation or visible office depth, and the sign is flat black sans serif on bright silver rather than restrained warm raised serif lettering on a darker plate.
issues.fix: Add a layered brushed-metal roof rim, pane depth and varied lit rooms and reflections; darken and texture the plaque and use warm beveled serif lettering while retaining the intended sign stance and copy.

issues.where: beach case crop
issues.what: In addition to the heavy white pane edges and uniform diagonal glare, the beach reads as a flat turquoise and yellow image with a loose green leaf silhouette. The target has a palm with a visible trunk, a freestanding-looking angled chair, surf, and granular sand inside softly lit beveled glass.
issues.fix: Bring back the palm trunk, legible chair silhouette, foamy shoreline and sand texture; tint and soften the case edges and replace the repeated glare bands with smaller pane highlights.

issues.where: long table crop and adjacent paper slips
issues.what: The long axis is turned by a quarter turn; rail-thin chairs don't read as padded seats, and the pale pads and loose-paper sequence are compressed into a yellow row at one end. The tabletop is very even and traced with linear bands.
issues.fix: Place the long axis across the left bay, line both long sides with fuller dark padded seats, and reinstate separate cream pads and staggered loose notes with paper edges and shadows. Give the wood natural grain and a darker polished finish.

issues.where: ladder crop and neighboring right slingshot
issues.what: The ramp entrance points almost sideways; the widely spread, angular rails and extra internal strokes form a cage that crosses the right slingshot instead of a clean diagonal climb along the right edge. The metal has little polished variation.
issues.fix: Restore the diagonal approach and open clean rung spacing, smooth the return, leave a visible gap to the right slingshot, and give the paired rails and entry shoe polished and brushed highlights respectively.

issues.where: revolving door crop and entrance carpet
issues.what: Four pale bars with a flat gold hub replace readable clear wings on a turned post. The carpet has uniform red striping and the entrance lamps sit in illustrated semicircles rather than appearing to spill light onto the blue surface.
issues.fix: Make the pane faces and fine edges readable under this view and give the turned hub brass relief; replace striped shading with fine pile and circular painted-looking pools with softly lit reflections.

issues.where: flipper and slingshot crops, also mirrored across whole tier
issues.what: The flipper looks ocher and almost matte, without the crisp glossy orange cap, dark rubber stripe and proud screw head. The slingshot has sparse dark drawn cracks in a gray gradient, with no convincingly thick luminous metal layers beneath it.
issues.fix: Give the flippers a clear-coated orange cap, continuous dark rubber belt and dimensional hardware; build up layered polished slingshot rims, fine cloudy white stone veining and individual screw and bumper highlights.

issues.where: floor inserts and small lamps flanking the flippers
issues.what: The icons float in dark intense saturated glows with multiple concentric gold bands; the surrounding warm lamps have blown centers with lost icon detail. The target shows softly lit milky glass faces with crisp dark marks, thin rings and warmer pinpoints.
issues.fix: Use pale translucent lenses, clearer line art and shallower center-to-edge falloff backed by a simpler metal bezel, controlling bloom so the small symbols survive.

issues.where: lift bend crop and the left tube wall
issues.what: The elbow is dull yellow-brown and the tube resembles blue-gray vertical linework rather than a clear curved wall joined to a glossy orange molded casing with chrome collars.
issues.fix: Increase orange saturation and specular definition on the housing; give the tube cylindrical refraction with visibly rounded glass rims and bright narrow collars without closing its openings.

issues.where: name plate crop
issues.what: The fascia is pale, heavily horizontally banded and printed with dark sans-serif characters. The target has cool dark brushed metal and subdued raised serif characters with narrow lit edges and small relief shadows.
issues.fix: Darken the fascia, refine the scale of the brush grain, and model raised warm-gray serif characters with a fine bevel and contact shadow, retaining the approved words.

issues.where: doorway and tower crops
issues.what: A flat yellow-orange portal and bright uniform checkerboard reflections flatten the glass, and repetitive evenly lit ceiling units dominate the tower. The target shows aged brass trim at several depths, smoky blue mullions, distinct floors, broken-up reflections and warmer individual rooms.
issues.fix: Layer the door trim in darker brushed brass, use more selective diffused interior light and pane reflections, and render stacked warm office interiors through cooler, deeper window bays.

issues.where: arrow and its sphere
issues.what: The arrow reads as a tall bright-white planar dart with a hard flat gray stroke and sharp notch. The glass introduces distracting dark crossing arcs and an almost unbroken white rim, rather than the target's quieter rounded gray relief and clustered, warmer irregular highlights.
issues.fix: Keep the prescribed arrow and ball sizes; use a rounder silhouette and a darker dimensional bevel with a soft satin face, then remove the crossing glass lines and use localized broken glints, soft refraction, and subtle internal flecks.

issues.where: revolving-door post and globe lamps
issues.what: The revolving panes have thick uniformly blue-white rounded edges and a yellow largely unmodulated post, while the near globe uses a gold stalk or cup silhouetted under a featureless white ball. The target has thin clear beveled wings with warmer reflections, a deeply turned bronze post and frosted globes on stepped cool-metal bases.
issues.fix: Thin the apparent glass edge highlights, warm and vary their reflections, add dark grooves and fine polish to the post, and give the globes graded frost with more clearly stepped steel hardware and localized floor reflections.

issues.where: Corporate tier, center stack and lower playfield layout
issues.what: The top lane occupies an especially deep band, while the entrance carpet, slingshots and insert cluster sit higher in their bay. The blue and amber discs are tucked tightly against the carpet, leaving no equivalent gaps between carpet, lamps and flippers.
issues.fix: Rebalance the projected tier layout with a shallower upper band and a more open carpet-to-insert-to-flipper progression; keep configured part sizes and the intended lower-right display.

issues.where: joins between the three tiers
issues.what: The central transfer openings read as flat square blocks across a frame seam, not as passages connected to the lane before and after them.
issues.fix: Make the center transfer geometry read as a chute with an obvious open path across each tier join, leaving the settled lift openings intact.

issues.where: middle tier, cups, machine and mail bay
issues.what: The cup trio is packed together in the upper center, with comparatively little depth stagger. The machine and mail bin are pinned in a narrow far-right strip with a prominent round opening in front, instead of two distinct machine and paper-receptacle positions on the right.
issues.fix: Open the cup triangle in the projected layout, set the coffee machine left of the mail bay with breathing room, and give the mail bin a visibly separate forward-facing feed opening.

issues.where: middle tier, cubicles, loose debris and floor section
issues.what: Cubicles are pinned against the left rail; most loose sheets are concentrated beside the flipper tips; an extra continuous beige cross strip cuts across the lane below the cubicles. The target distributes details in the upper bay around cubicles, cups and mail and leaves the flipper corners comparatively clear.
issues.fix: Give the cubicle bay some side clearance, break the continuous strip into the floor blocks around the central aisle, and distribute notes and clips closer to the upper workplaces along the side lanes.

issues.where: bottom tier, left buildings and right spiral
issues.what: The second left building is tucked under the red station beside a circular recess instead of being a distinct lower frontage. The small houses are relocated beside and below the flippers rather than at the building and spiral bases. The spiral overlaps the right slingshot's footprint.
issues.fix: Separate the left buildings along the lane, restore the rows of small houses at the bases of the relevant structures and keep the right spiral clear of the slingshot while holding part scales.

note: The critic sent this answer twice. The first ended with stray characters after the closing brace, which are dropped here. The second, a minute later, has the same score and the same 23 issues in the same order, in shorter words. The first is the one recorded.
